title: Book 7 — Polymnia, Chapter 122
paragraphs: The fleet, when it had been released by Xerxes and had sailed through the channel dug across Athos (which runs across to the gulf on which the cities of Assa, Pilorus, Singus, and Sarte are situated), having taken up a contingent from these cities as well, sailed from there with a fair passage into the Thermaic gulf. Rounding Ampelos, the headland of Torone, it left on one side the following Greek cities, from which it took up contingents of ships and men: Torone, Galepsus, Sermyle, Mecyberna, and Olynthus. This region is called Sithonia.
